---
title: "Contratos y cobros"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Contratos y cuentas por cobrar</h1><div class="tf-muted">Cada contrato puede cerrar por mes calendario o por ciclo aniversario. Los períodos pagados se preservan como histórico.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><button id="contract-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo contrato</button></div>

<section class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem"><div class="tf-section-heading"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Cartera contractual</div><h2>Todos los contratos</h2><div class="tf-muted">Activos y finalizados permanecen visibles. Abre Información para gestionar fechas, tarifa y cronograma.</div></div></div><div id="contract-list" class="tf-contract-list"></div></section>

<div id="receivables-section" class="tf-card" style="margin-top:1rem"><h2>Cuentas por cobrar</h2><div class="tf-toolbar"><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="payment-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto recibido ($)</label><input id="payment-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><button id="allocate-payment" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Aplicar a seleccionados</button></div><div class="tf-table-wrap" style="margin-top:.7rem"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th></th><th>Contrato</th><th>Período</th><th>Generado</th><th>Pagado</th><th>Pendiente</th><th>Vence</th><th>Estado</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="recv-body"></tbody></table></div></div>

<dialog id="contract-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-contract-editor-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Contratos</div><h2>Nuevo contrato</h2></div><button id="contract-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <form id="contract-form" class="tf-form-grid">
    <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Cliente / proyecto</label><input id="contract-name" required></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio trabajo</label><input id="contract-start" type="date"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Fin previsto (opcional)</label><input id="contract-end" type="date"></div>
    <div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Forma de cerrar el período</label><select id="contract-cycle-mode"><option value="calendar_month">Mes calendario / mes trabajado</option><option value="anniversary">Ciclo aniversario</option></select><small id="contract-cycle-help">Mes calendario conserva la prorrata actual. Ciclo aniversario cierra el día anterior al aniversario mensual.</small></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Desfase de pago (meses)</label><input id="contract-lag" type="number" min="0" value="6"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Día esperado de pago</label><input id="contract-pay-day" type="number" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Tarifa inicial mensual ($)</label><input id="contract-rate" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Transporte mensual estimado ($)</label><input id="contract-transport" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Otros costos directos mensuales ($)</label><input id="contract-other-cost" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
    <div class="tf-span-2"><label>Activos vinculados <span class="tf-muted">(opcional)</span></label><div id="contract-allocations" class="tf-plan-source-list"></div><div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:.5rem"><button id="add-contract-allocation" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Añadir activo</button><span id="allocation-total" class="tf-muted">Sin activos vinculados</span></div></div>
    <div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions tf-sticky-actions"><button id="contract-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar contrato</button></div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<dialog id="contract-asset-dialog" class="tf-dialog"><form method="dialog" onsubmit="return false" class="tf-dialog-card"><div class="tf-dialog-header"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Activo opcional</div><h2>Vincular activo</h2></div></div><div class="tf-dialog-body"><div class="tf-field"><label>Activo</label><select id="contract-asset-select"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Participación (%)</label><input id="contract-asset-percent" type="number" min="0.1" max="100" step="0.1" value="100"></div></div><div class="tf-dialog-actions"><button id="contract-asset-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button><button id="contract-asset-add" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Añadir</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="tariff-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Contrato en operación</div><h2 id="tariff-title">Nueva tarifa</h2></div><button id="tariff-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="tariff-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Vigente desde</label><input id="tariff-from" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tarifa mensual ($)</label><input id="tariff-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions tf-sticky-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Agregar tarifa</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="contract-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-contract-detail-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Contrato</div><h2 id="contract-detail-title">Detalle contractual</h2></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" id="contract-detail-close">Cerrar</button></div><div id="contract-detail-body"></div></dialog>

<dialog id="contract-payment-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog tf-contract-payment-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Ingreso contractual</div><h2 id="contract-payment-title">Registrar cobro</h2><div id="contract-payment-meta" class="tf-muted"></div></div><button id="contract-payment-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact">Cerrar</button></div><div class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="contract-payment-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto recibido ($)</label><input id="contract-payment-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="contract-payment-date" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><input id="contract-payment-description"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions" style="justify-content:flex-end"><button id="contract-payment-save" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar</button></div></div></dialog>

<dialog id="contract-finish-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><form method="dialog" id="contract-finish-form"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Cierre contractual</div><h2>Finalizar / programar fin</h2></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" value="cancel">Cerrar</button></div><div class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha efectiva de finalización</label><input id="contract-finish-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-span-2" id="contract-finish-preview"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions" style="justify-content:flex-end"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" value="cancel">Cancelar</button><button id="contract-finish-confirm" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar fecha</button></div></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="contract-dates-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Fechas contractuales</div><h2>Editar inicio y fin</h2><div id="contract-dates-meta" class="tf-muted"></div></div><button id="contract-dates-close" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary tf-btn-compact">Cerrar</button></div><div class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha de inicio</label><input id="contract-dates-start" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha de fin</label><input id="contract-dates-end" type="date"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-muted">Al guardar, solo se recalculan períodos sin pagos. Los períodos pagados o parciales se conservan.</div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions" style="justify-content:flex-end"><button id="contract-dates-save" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar fechas</button></div></div></dialog>
<script type="module" src="js/contracts.js?v=1.0.87"></script>
```
